page.notes: Layout is two parallel columns; the cell order and line pairing were read from the scan and are approximate in places. Several readings are doubtful: "7%" (first entry page number), the abbreviations in "ius fectum", "g#t" (gat.), "episcopus" and "copus datus", the catchword, and the final line "fcha" at the foot, which may be the catchword or a signature. The number "4" at the very bottom of the scan is not clearly a page number and is left out. Right margin cell numbers may be misaligned with their entries.
